title: 船用海水淡化裝置
summary: 從海水進水、膜分離到產水儲存建立質量與能量帳，避免把回收率當純度。 在海水淡化與水質模型室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Build mass/energy balances from seawater feed through membrane separation to storage, without confusing recovery and purity. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Marine desalination and water-quality model laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 產水回收率與濃水流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Permeate recovery and brine flow: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 產水回收率與濃水流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Permeate recovery and brine flow and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船用海水淡化裝置」的「產水回收率與濃水流」中，膜系統產水回收率與鹽截留率是不同指標。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：從海水進水、膜分離到產水儲存建立質量與能量帳，避免把回收率當純度。
steps.instructionEn: Within Marine freshwater production, Permeate recovery and brine flow examines this mechanism: Membrane water recovery and salt rejection are different metrics. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Build mass/energy balances from seawater feed through membrane separation to storage, without confusing recovery and purity.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：進水10 m³/h，產水3.5 m³/h。關係式 Y=Qp/Qf；含單位換算算式 3.5/10*100 = 35 %。適用條件：只做水量帳；不能由回收率推論飲用水品質。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Feed 10 m³/h and permeate 3.5 m³/h. Relation Y=Qp/Qf; expression including unit conversion 3.5/10*100 = 35 %. Applicability: Water balance only; recovery does not establish potable-water quality.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：提高回收率可能提高濃差極化，不等同提高截鹽。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Higher recovery can increase concentration polarization without improving rejection. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「產水回收率與濃水流」，寫出進水=產水+濃水，另外檢查導電度與分析資料。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
